title: Move all records/ readers to the athena/records worktree, with inventory
summary: Define the athena/records worktree path once in athena-data paths.rs, add load_current forms to Records::load and RecordSet::load, and move every live reader (including gh.rs land_pr and the introspect.rs directory walks) with fallback to in-tree records/ when the worktree is absent. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier. The earlier critic findings (gh.rs, qualified-path matching, introspect) are closed items; the site generator is out of scope.

defaults_applied.how: Reader tests plus a scan test; fmt, clippy and cargo test must pass.
Criteria check readers returning worktree records, not that the path exists.
Behavior criteria name the cargo commands the verifier can run.
A scan test guards against missed readers instead of a one-off patch.
Decisions and CHANGELOG entries are written for an outside reader.
The scan and the land_pr demonstration check the outcome, which is that no reader reads stale in-tree records.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Call-site inventory from a grep of the current tree (not from memory). Live non-test hits to MOVE: status.rs 605/612/613/818; review.rs 254; proposals.rs 556/557/619/640/643/669; auditor.rs 300; run.rs 165/361/2392; audience.rs 229; manage.rs 94/194/313/447/511/534; reading.rs 532/556/599/630/701/722/1727; hestia.rs 108/142; work_decisions.rs 311/315/342/358; scope_guard.rs 635; code_health.rs 712/735; steward.rs 244/257; watcher.rs 346; gh.rs 2513 (land_pr, qualified crate::store::Records::load); introspect.rs 300/318/339/360 (directory walks, move to the records root) and 1246/1283/1314/1315; cli drain.rs 1463; cli backtest.rs 510 (read_records(root)); xtask walltime.rs 83.

Treeish judges that take a caller-given commit stay unchanged and are allow-listed with a reason: gate reconcile.rs 187/193/212/217, history.rs 188/263, attribution.rs read_records(git, tip), store.rs 275 (inside Records::load itself), and the landing and cutover code. Test-only hits are excluded from the scan.

gate records.rs, jobs.rs, audit.rs, cli main.rs and decisions.rs are kept as deliverables at low probability because they may hold further readers; the producer re-runs the scan to settle them, so none is left undecided.

The scan matches the Records::load( and RecordSet::load( suffix whatever the path prefix, so crate::store::Records::load( and GitRecords::load( are caught. It also matches join("records...") and read_records( on a repo dir. A planted crate::store::Records::load(git, head) case must fail it.
The study site generator xtask/src/site.rs reads studies/, not records/. It is left untouched and shown to build identically with and without records/.
The scan is run once against the real tree before it is relied on, and its command must execute a nonzero test count.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test puts different records in the athena/records worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that each moved reader returns the worktree's records: Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, introspect read_records, backtest read_records, xtask walltime, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, introspection, and the other readers in the inventory. Run cargo test --locked.
A test using a real-git fixture whose HEAD has no records/ loads the records through the worktree. A negative control shows the same test fails on the old HEAD-based load. Run cargo test --locked.
A test calls land_pr (athena land) on a checkout whose HEAD has no records/ and shows it resolves the job's verification and candidate from the worktree. Run cargo test --locked.

With no worktree present, each moved reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. athena status and a forecast succeed on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.
The worktree path is defined once in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs beside repo_state_dir. No non-test reader joins records/ itself outside paths.rs and the fallback.

An xtask scan test named records_reader_scan fails on planted direct reads, including a qualified crate::store::Records::load(git, head), join("records") and read_records(<repo dir>). It passes on the real tree with a documented allow-list in which every entry has a reason. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan and confirm nonzero tests ran.
The study site generator xtask/src/site.rs is unchanged and its output is identical with records/ present and with it absent. Run cargo run -p xtask -- site both ways and compare.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and the full cargo test --locked pass, with existing tests unchanged.
docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.

out_of_scope: Changing treeish judges in athena-gate (reconcile, history, attribution) that evaluate a caller-given commit
Creating the athena/records branch or the cutover itself (job 20261025-001232-vesh)
departures: The change spans about 25 files and the previous two attempts failed in planning, so cost and time are higher and the pass probability is lower than the reference.
urgent_reason: Priority is high, and this retry cuts the repeated planning failures: it carries a call-site inventory from a real grep, with gh.rs and introspect decided, so the critic does not hit new sites in its last round.
